scope: Retained baseline ordinary relay39 run, no configured burst. Strict same-Page request/parent timestamps establish the registered RAF wait. Cross-process alignment uses recorded performance.timeOrigin+performance.now and is approximate wall-clock alignment, not a calibrated OS/native receive clock. Frame identities and ordered fresh-input receive cohorts provide separate corroboration. No GPU trace or root-cause proof.
limitations: Synthetic touch timer execution is not physical input timing.
First native input wire observation is send-intent, not exact capture/send completion/OS arrival.
Setup and delayed end window snapshots do not determine the native window state during the wait; Page visible/active is a diagnostic qualification, not physical visibility proof.
Correlation and input starvation sequence do not identify compositor, GPU driver, operating system, or background compile as the cause.
